in_sanskrit.name: जुहीया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Juhiyaa is derived from the Sanskrit word जुही (juhi), which means 'to shine', 'to radiate', or 'to illuminate'. The suffix -या (-yaa) is added to the root to denote femininity. Thus, Juhiyaa can be interpreted as a 'Radiant' or 'Shining' woman.
